profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: I love teaching, building, and learning. An unexplored set of data is one of the most exciting things in the world.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Co-creator of the Quoth iOS app. We use the magic of computer vision (and a hefty database of quotes) to automatically find the perfect quote for your photo! We are iOS only for now, but will release an Android version as soon as I get around to learning Java.

positions.title: Curriculum Lead - School of Autonomous Systems
positions.description: Responsible for the design and development of courses in the Self-Driving Car and Flying Car Nanodegree curricula. I got to learn a TON about these incredible technologies while helping subject matter experts creating engaging videos and immersive programming exercises.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Work on the Gigster network as a freelance software engineer. I build iOS apps, backends in Python, and machine learning models.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description: I built machine learning models to help employers find the perfect candidates for jobs!

positions.title: Lead Instructor
positions.description:
I love this job. I get to do so many things:

 I make courses. 
 I help other people make courses and offer guidance about their pedagogical decisions.
 I work with engineers and product managers to help guide Udacity technology in the best possible way for our students. 
 I get to think about learning, programming, and the internet and how to fuse the three in a way that is demonstrable, rigorous, personalized, joyful, and social.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: I biked around Boston and helped people learn things. Pretty fun actually.

projects.title: Make your own 2048 (class)
projects.description: The purpose of this class is to have fun learning how to quickly and easily take an existing open source program, make some changes, and create something that looks and feels completely new. The game you create will be mobile friendly (you can play it on your phone!) and totally shareable.

projects.title: Introduction to Salesforce App Development (class)
projects.description:
This class teaches you to make simple business apps without doing any coding. 

The platform can be tricky to navigate at first, but once you get into it it's actually a great tool to let you hide away all the details of a problem and focus only on the high level stuff.
